what_happened.line: The School Committee approved the new grades 6-8 English language arts curriculum; grants cover part of the first-year costs.
It approved four finance policies on a third read, with an Oxford comma corrected.
It authorized administration to spend any leftover ESSER (SR2) funds on technology as of June 30; administration will report back in late August or early September.
It approved an end-of-year line-item transfer to cover negative balances, including substitute lines, and accepted the quarterly budget report.
The committee heard rough estimates from the municipal building committee for a new Turkey Hill build, town hall and the Ritter building, then went into executive session.

why_it_matters: The curriculum adoption and the ESSER technology authorization touch what the schools buy next year, and the ESSER money expires September 30, 2023, so it cannot fund anything after that.
The building estimates for Turkey Hill, town hall and the Ritter building are early concepts for the select board. Any project would reach residents later as a spending vote.
